runs.title: A 0.5B model is too small to learn from its own docs
runs.what: First real-model run: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, 2 simulated days, arms base / rag / sdft.
runs.lesson: Self-distillation can only copy what the teacher (the model with the docs in its prompt) can do. Even with the docs, 0.5B barely solved anything, so there was nothing to distill.

runs.title: Coder-7B: teacher at 54%, and every miss was the same mistake
runs.what: Preflight: day 1 of base / rag / sdft with Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct at full budgets.
runs.lesson: The teacher solved one task type 13/13 and the other 0/11, always by calling .unravel() on the result of knot(). The docs never said knot returns a plain value. A gap in the docs, not in the model.

runs.title: One doc line fixed: teacher 24/24, but the student didn't move yet
runs.what: Same preflight after stating knot's return type (and auditing every module's docs).
runs.lesson: The teacher is now strong, so there is real signal to distill. After one night the closed-book student switched to the teacher's chained style but still used the wrong method names: one short training pass was too little. General reasoning was unharmed.

runs.title: A stronger night: 12/12 closed-book, including a task type it never trained on
runs.what: Same day 1, sdft only, three versions of the nightly update. Every pass re-samples the student's own attempts after the previous update; 2 attempts per optimizer step; LoRA rank 16.
runs.lesson: One pass at lr 1e-4 barely nudged the weights. Five passes at 5e-4 moved the student from 0/12 to 12/12 with no docs in its prompt, including 4/4 on the held-out task type, and reasoning stayed at 93%. At 1e-3 it over-learned: it used knot() even where the answer had to be a list. 5e-4 is now the default for both sft and sdft.
